Read `AGENTS.md` and the README before proposing changes.

LaraSaaS 2.x is a Laravel Composer library. Production plans are admin-managed database records; config defines only typed feature capabilities and display/integration settings. Do not confuse paid plan entitlements with Pennant rollout flags, or the Next.js demo with the package backend.

Keep pricing public, billing private, admin Gate-protected, and all embed writes signed. Preserve archived subscription price mappings. Fresh installation publishes one LaraSaaS migration; upgrades are additive. Never overwrite historical migrations or seed demo plans. Run the PHP compatibility matrix and shipped React typecheck, and document breaking changes and migration steps.
